options.name: access_token
options.description: An OAuth2 access token if credential type is accesstoken.

options.name: description
options.description: A mutable string of at most 1024 characters associated with this resource for the user's convenience. Has no effect on the managed zone's function.

options.name: dns_name
options.description: The DNS name of this managed zone, for instance "example.com.".

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: forwarding_config
options.description: The presence for this field indicates that outbound forwarding is enabled for this zone. The value of this field contains the set of destinations to forward to.

options.name: labels
options.description: A set of key/value label pairs to assign to this ManagedZone.

options.name: name
options.description: User assigned name for this resource. Must be unique within the project.

options.name: name_server_set
options.description: Optionally specifies the NameServerSet for this ManagedZone. A NameServerSet is a set of DNS name servers that all host the same ManagedZones. Most users will leave this field unset.

options.name: peering_config
options.description: The presence of this field indicates that DNS Peering is enabled for this zone. The value of this field contains the network to peer with.

options.name: private_visibility_config
options.description: For privately visible zones, the set of Virtual Private Cloud resources that the zone is visible from.

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the given object should exist in GCP

options.name: visibility
options.description: The zone's visibility: public zones are exposed to the Internet, while private zones are visible only to Virtual Private Cloud resources. Some valid choices include: "private", "public"
